title: Custom Football Helmet with Flaming Football Comforter
description:
Transform your space into the ultimate football experience with this custom sports-themed comforter set by Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this bedding set brings the spirit of the game directly to your bedroom. Featuring a striking, vibrant digital illustration design, it serves as both a cozy layer of breathable warmth and a stylish piece of sports home decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customization options allow you to personalize your bedding with up to 2 text inputs, including a Name and Number.
  • Cozy & Soft Comfort: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Choose the perfect fit for your bed with options including Twin (68" x 88" or 68"x90"), Full (78" x 88" or 79"x90"), Queen (88" x 88" or 90"x90"), and King (104" x 88" or 104"x90").
  • Versatile Included Components: Each package includes 1 Duvet Cover or Comforter, with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet covers based on your selection.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water. Tumble dry on low heat or air dry without heat for quick, fluffy results.
  • Superior Durability: Features environmental protection printing techniques to prevent fading, along with smooth, fine, and compact edge stitching.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester with Microfiber Filling
Fabric Type Polyester
Selected Design Football & Helmet on Fire
Style Contemporary
Theme Football
Pattern Football & Helmet on Fire
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Do not bleach, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
